# agy layout manifests

One path per line, relative to `home/.gemini/antigravity-cli/`; the test helper `build_layout`
creates each as an empty file. Lines starting with `#` are comments, except the directive
`#generate brain N`, which creates N empty files `brain/e<i>`. Ids are the conversation ids of
`../payloads/*.json`: 534e47d6 (top-level), 5781d6c5 (child), e806a19d (after /clear), ccac2ead
(resumed).
